extracted.intended_audience: general readers of history and historical biography (readers interested in Renaissance Italy, the Borgias, and Savonarola)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical narrative describing events and personalities around Pope Alexander VI, Cesare Borgia, and Girolamo Savonarola in late 15th-century Italy. The text recounts episodes, trials, public spectacles, and political maneuvers in a literary/historical mode.
